blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “I am amazed at the man who buys slaves with his wealth and then sets them free. Why does he not buy free people by treating people well? Is its reward not greater? (If he treats people beautifully, people will become his slaves)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَنَازَعِيْمٌ بِبَيْتٍ فِيْ رَبَضِ الْجَنَّةِ لِمَنْ تَرَكَ الْمِرَاءَ وَاِنْ كَانَ مُحِقًّا، وَبِبَيْتٍ فِيْ وَسَطِ الْجَنَّةِ لِمَنْ تَرَكَ الْكَذِبَ وَاِنْ كَانَ مَازِحًا، وَبِبَيْتٍ فِيْ اَعْلَي الْجَنَّةِ لِمَنْ حَسَّنَ خُلُقَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في حسن الخلق رقم:٤٨٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “I take responsibility for securing a mansion on the edge of Jannah for the man who gives up arguing even though he is in the right. I take responsibility for securing a mansion in the middle of Jannah for the man who gives up lying even in jest. Whoever makes his character beautiful, I take responsibility for securing for him a mansion in the highest part of Jannah” — Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ لَقِيَ اَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ بِمَا يُحِبُّ اللهُ لِيَسُرَّهُ بِذلِكَ، سَرَّهُ اللهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الصغير واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:٨ /٣٥٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever meets a Muslim brother (with a cheerful face) in order to please him in a way that Allah Ta'ala loves, Allah Ta'ala
